statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail eases further as the reopened futures session digests the Nvidia result in an orderly, narrow range, with volatility, yields and oil showing no aligned confirmation of a one-way path.
recommendation: Conditional attention concentrates in the narrow 13:00-15:00 UTC window on Aug 27 covering the U.S. cash open, the first cash auction to price the overnight gap in full liquidity. The Asian open near 00:00 UTC and the European open at 07:00 UTC are nearer regional checkpoints of lesser weight. Outside those windows the mapped state stays at the calm baseline that governed the prior night. Tail remains well below the block threshold. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Nvidia's beat and raised outlook hold overnight; NQ futures sit about 1% higher in a narrow post-reopen range and Tail eases to 16
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed at 29,224.52, up 0.05%, inside a narrow 0.69% band of 29,096.84-29,296.77, a two-way session with no directional efficiency. NVIDIA reported fiscal Q2 2027 results after the close: revenue $96.2bn, up 106% year on year against roughly $92.3bn consensus, data-centre revenue $89bn, earnings of $2.22 per share against $2.09, gross margin near 75%, and third-quarter guidance of $108bn plus or minus 2% against roughly $104bn consensus. Reported alongside: supply commitments rose from $119bn to $279bn, largely memory procurement; gross margin is guided to trough near 71-72% in fiscal Q4; and Amazon Web Services was announced as a buyer of two million GPUs together with the new Vera CPU. CME equity futures were in their scheduled 21:00-22:00 UTC halt for the whole conference call. Since the 22:00 UTC reopen the September NQ contract has traded around 29,590-29,606 against the 29,289.50 prior close, up about 1.03-1.08%, on roughly 13,400 contracts, holding the gap in a band of about 40 points without extending. NVDA changed hands at $218.42 after hours, up 4.18% on the $209.66 cash close, which was itself down 1.59% into the print. Cross-assets are calm and not aligned behind the equity move: the 10-year yield edged up 1.9bp to 4.65% and the 2-year up 3.5bp to 4.22% after July PCE printed 3.7% year on year against 3.6% expected with core at 3.3% in line, VIX fell 1.55% to 15.21, and WTI slipped 0.16% to $81.81 with Brent down 1.26% to $87.47 on reported diplomatic progress over the Strait of Hormuz. Latest-session breadth was mixed, with three of eight megacaps higher and semiconductors firm excluding NVIDIA itself. The observed path is therefore a repriced level rather than a one-way trend: the binary that dominated the week resolved benignly, the gap has held without extension, and no independent amplifier is aligned behind it.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours ran a calm regime that tightened only around the Nvidia print. Tail held between 9 and 16 with the mapped state EA_ON/green from 23:00 UTC on Aug 25 through 19:00 UTC on Aug 26. Overnight and European hours were assessed as normal mode near Tail 11. The 12:00 UTC hour shifted to event/whipsaw at Tail 16 around the July PCE release, then decayed to mixed mode and Tail 10-11 through the afternoon while Stress climbed from 46 to 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC hour moved to WATCH/yellow at Tail 21 and Stress 66 for the release window, and the 22:00 UTC reopen hour returned to EA_ON/green at Tail 18. No assessment was published for the 21:00 UTC clock hour, which covered the futures halt and is marked unavailable rather than reconstructed.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are governed by one resolved catalyst and a sequence of regional repricing checkpoints. The Nvidia release and conference call are behind the assessment and the reopened futures session has held a roughly 1% gap without extending, so conditional Tail decays from 16 through Asian and European hours toward the 12-13 baseline that governed the prior night, assuming orderly discovery with visible retracements. The Asian cash open near 00:00 UTC and the European open at 07:00 UTC are the first and second regional auctions to price the result, each a modest checkpoint. Second-tier U.S. data at 12:30 UTC weighs on Stress and Confidence rather than Tail. The principal checkpoint is the U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC on Aug 27, the first cash auction to price the gap in full liquidity; conditional Tail returns to the watch band for that single hour as a scheduled checkpoint and not on observed structure, then decays again through the afternoon. A seven-year note auction at 17:00 UTC and the final cash hour are minor structural checkpoints, and the 21:00-22:00 UTC halt mechanically removes the price path before the next reopen.
